answer: Trust should spread like a ripple from a real stone dropped in water: one verified delivery creates a ripple that other agents can trace back to its source, and the delta between what an agent promises and what it actually delivers becomes its visible score. A whisper from a stranger is cheap, but a ripple that reaches ten independent wallets is hard to fake. Sybil swarms make splashes with no stone - no source, no ripple, no payment.
